kurz: Warm a bowl over or in hot water. The temperature rises gently and cannot exceed 100 °C.
bild_im_kopf: Like a buffer between flame and bowl: the water absorbs the peaks.
was_passiert: The water spreads the heat evenly and limits it. That way egg custards, hollandaise or chocolate do not curdle or seize so easily.
schritte: Bring a pot with a little water to a simmer.
Set the bowl on top; it should not touch the water.
Lift the bowl off briefly if it is going too fast.
